items.item_text: Certified Diabetes Educator
Bachelors in Arts or Science (preferred in Nutrition and Dietetics)

Under the direction of the Clinic Manager, Clinic Director, and Medical Director of the Men’s Clinic at UCLA Health, the Registered Dietitian will lead the development, implementation, and evaluation of comprehensive nutrition services for patients across the continuum of care. This role is responsible for conducting nutrition assessments, creating individualized nutrition care plans, monitoring patient progress, and providing evidence-based counseling and education to support overall health and wellness goals.

The Dietitian will facilitate patient education programs, lead nutrition focused classes, serve as a key resource for patients and families, and support the coordination of patient support groups. The incumbent will collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary healthcare team to optimize patient outcomes, integrate current nutrition research into clinical practice, and participate in quality improvement and research initiatives as appropriate.

In addition, this role will support medical weight management programs, including working with patients utilizing GLP-1 and other emerging weight loss therapies. The Dietitian will partner with Nurse Practitioners, Licensed Vocational Nurses, and other clinical staff as a member of the weight management task force to deliver coordinated, patient centered care and promote sustainable lifestyle changes.
Registered Dietitian (RD) by the Commission on Dietetic Registration
Ability to provide dietary counseling according to protocol

Ability to work independently and exercise initiative with only minimal direction in a one-person office and to establish and meet deadlines
